verses.gurmukhi: ੭ : ਮੂਰਖ ਪੱਥਰ ਹੈ ਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 7 : moorakh pa'thar hai sa(n)g vich kusa(n)gee rahi(n)dhaa hai

en.bdb: The fool is a stone; he remains adamant in any company

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paaras pathar sa(n)g hai paaras paras na ka(n)chan hovai|

en.bdb: Ordinary stone may be in contact with the philosopher's stone but it does not get transformed into gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੇ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਥਰਹੁ ਪਥਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: heere maanak patharahu pathar koi na haar parovai|

en.bdb: Diamonds and rubies are extracted from the stones but the latter cannot be stringed as a necklace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਟਿ ਜਵਾਹਰੁ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਇ ਸਮੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaT javaahar toleeaai mul na tul vikai samovai|

en.bdb: The jewels are weighed with weights but the latter cannot equate in value with the jewels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਵੰਨ ਅਲੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar a(n)dhar asaTadhaat paaras paras suva(n)n alovai|

en.bdb: Eight metals (alloys) remain amidst stones but they convert into gold by the touch of philosopher's stone alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰੁ ਫਟਕ ਝਲਕਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar faTak jhalakanaa bahu ra(n)gee hoi ra(n)g na govai|

en.bdb: Crystal stone shines in many colours but still remains a mere stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਸਾਉ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਕਠੋਰ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar vaas na saau hai man kaThor hoi aap vigovai|

en.bdb: Stone has neither fragrance nor taste; the hard-hearted one simply destroys itself.
The foolish goes on lamenting his own stupidity.
